# Ruby lexical receiver fixture

`update_pbem.rb` is the complete diagnostic-corpus original from repository `88_Protocol-Buffers_yasha`, original path `update_pbem.rb`. Its 3,343 bytes, 125 CRLF pairs and final newline are retained without normalization. SHA-256: `a8870ae6b9c440c2d87bc8d47105d976bd6a302f8cd5e2c06cfedfa75086182c`.

The accompanying original MIT `LICENSE` retains copyright (c) 2014 Elo Entertainment LLC. Both files are test data; no upstream build tool or executable hook is activated. The fixture exercises a prior program-local assignment captured by an ordinary Ruby block. It does not assert execution of the generator, the generated Go source, or any external dependency.
